'''Zhar''' was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] located in the [[Zhar system]] of the [[Cadavine sector/Legends|Cadavine sector]]. Of its dozen [[Moon/Legends|moons]], two were terrestrial. One of them, [[Gall/Legends|Gall]], was the site of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] enclave. [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] set up a temporary base on the other, [[Kile]], from which they launched an attempt to capture [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and rescue [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], then trapped in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]].

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Secrets of Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'' and the ''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]'' both identify this planet as "'''Zahr'''."

''The Secrets of Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' also claims that Zhar is located in the same [[Star system/Legends|star system]] as [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Secrets:SOTE">''[[The Secrets of Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]''</ref> However, Zhar is [[canon]]ically located in the [[Zhar system]],<ref name="SOTE Sourcebook">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> while Tatooine is located in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]].<ref name="Edge of the Empire">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>
